message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The facts: Wang introduced others to virtually issue VAT special invoices for profit, 46 VAT special invoices, tax amount 180,828.63 yuan, used for deduction, causing tax loss. Also found many forged invoices (general machine printed invoices and ordinary VAT invoices). He confessed. The company refunded tax. So crimes: virtual issuance of VAT special invoices (虚开增值税专用发票罪) used for tax deduction. Also forging invoices (伪造发票). Possibly also illegal acquisition of tax revenue (逃税? but main is虚开增值税专用发票). In examples, they often list "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". Here it's for deduction, not export. So "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取抵扣税款发票". Also "伪造、变造发票". In earlier examples, they combine: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". For this case, also "伪造发票". So final answer likely: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取抵扣税款发票;伪造发票<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法牟利" but not a crime. So answer as multiple separated by semicolon.

Thus final JSON.
